query: Marvell Technology data center revenue Q4 fiscal 2026 full year fiscal 2026
normalized: 2026 center data fiscal full marvell q4 revenue technology year

output.content:
Marvell Technology’s data-center revenue was **$1.651 billion in Q4 fiscal 2026** (the quarter ended January 31, 2026), representing **74%** of total quarterly revenue; it increased **21% year over year** and **9% sequentially**. [[1]] 

For **full-year fiscal 2026**, data-center revenue **exceeded $6.0 billion**, up **46% year over year**. [[2]] 

For context, Marvell’s total company revenue was **$2.219 billion in Q4** and **$8.195 billion for FY2026**. [[1]]
